steps: For median PT, T midpoint of QR
check_code:
import random
from fractions import Fraction as F
random.seed(1)
P=(F(1),F(7));Q=(F(-3),F(0));R=(F(8),F(2))
T=((Q[0]+R[0])/2,(Q[1]+R[1])/2)
d=lambda a,b:(a[0]-b[0])**2+(a[1]-b[1])**2
lhs=d(P,Q)+d(P,R)
opts={'A':d(P,T)+d(Q,R),'B':2*(d(P,T)+d(Q,T)),'C':d(P,T)+d(Q,T),'D':2*(d(P,T)-d(Q,T))}
assert lhs==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD':
    assert lhs!=opts[k]
